Subject: POC runway: hands-on lab scheduling + prep packet

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team loved the throughput numbers. We're ready to move to a hands-on POC to validate routing and load behavior on our typical prompt sets. Goals for the working session: prompt review & tuning, routing policy walkthrough, and a focused load test (targeting our burst profile).

Can you share available 2.5–3 hour slots next week? Ideally we'd do a hands-on session where our app team can make live requests and you can help tune batching/caching. We have broad timezone constraints (PDT).

Participants from our side: Samantha (PM), IT Ops (network owner), and possibly Marcus (apps).

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Jones
Product Manager, Acme PDX

Samantha — thanks, excited to run this. Proposed plan and immediate asks below.

Proposed 3-hour slots (PDT):
- Tue 2027-06-29 09:30–12:30
- Wed 2027-06-30 13:00–16:00
- Thu 2027-07-01 09:00–12:00

Quick agenda (attached):
- 0:00–0:15 Introductions & objectives
- 0:15–1:00 Prompt review & example tuning (bring a handful of production prompts)
- 1:00–1:15 Break
- 1:15–2:00 Routing policy & model variant fallbacks
- 2:00–2:45 Load test: staged bursts and KV/prefix cache checks
- 2:45–3:00 Next steps + ownerships

Attachments: [POC-runway-agenda.pdf], [prompt-checklist.md] — prompt checklist contains example payload sizes we'll ask you to prepare.

Ben (SE) and Dev (infra) are copied — Ben will own the live tuning and Dev will run the load harness. Ben: can you confirm capacity for the load test and any network requirements?

If you prefer splitting into two half-days (prompt tuning day + load day) say so and we'll propose half-day options.

Olga Petrov
